verses.1: To be destroyed upon the hilltops, children of snow. From a prophecy.
verses.2: What kind of friends are those who dwell in your homes, O Lord’s armies?
verses.3: My soul is filled with joy; my heart and my words are filled with praise for the Lord.
verses.4: Also, there was a dove found in the house. And a crow also found a nest for it. It drank from the nectar of your sacrifices, O LORD, God of hosts and gods.
verses.5: May those who dwell in your house still praise you.
verses.6: For men who are stubborn in their hearts, they will be punished by God.
verses.7: Those who cross the steep cliffs of Baqah will also be blessed with good fortune.
verses.8: They will go from one tribe to another, and they will see God in His glory.
verses.9: Yehovah, God, hear my prayers. Listen to me, O God of Jacob!
verses.10: May God protect us, and may He see your face.
verses.11: For it is good to have a day in your courtyard. I have chosen one thousand from among them. They are gathered together in the house of God, from the chambers of righteousness.
verses.12: For the light and protection of Jehovah God bring grace and favor. Jehovah will not withhold good from those who walk in His ways.
verses.13: YHWH, your armies, who give people confidence in you.
